text:
Priya (CSM): Quick sync — Gamma onboarding & dedicated capacity health. Sharing 7-day KPIs: GPU hours 2,480 (+55% w/w), pool 'gamma' saturation peaked 92% Tue 03:40 UTC, queue depth median 14, p95 46, avg wait 17s. Spend trending +38% MoM. Noticeable token-level spikes from nightly reruns. Thoughts?

Eli (Platform): Can you paste the 48h per-tenant breakdown?

Priya (CSM): Sure — copying the small breakdown we pulled from billing+metrics:
```
tenant breakdown (48h):
acme-beta: 1480 GPU hours (60%)
polaris: 520 GPU hours (21%)
internal-tests: 300 GPU hours (12%)
others: 180 GPU hours (7%)
```

Eli (Platform): Ok, acme-beta is the main driver. They kicked off large batched evals overnight. Probable cause: scheduled batch window + high batch-size param. Short-term mitigations: per-tenant concurrency cap and temporary burst nodes.

Sam (SRE): I can spin up burst nodes for pool 'gamma' for the next 24h to knock down queue depth. Will monitor queue and p95. Deploy window?

Maya (CS Ops): I'll reach out to acme-beta and ask them to pause the nightly full-evals until we stabilize. Also will offer a quick enablement call to adjust batching.

Priya (CSM): Proposed immediate action items: 1) Sam: add 4 burst nodes to gamma by 10:00 UTC; 2) Eli: set per-tenant concurrency limit = 8 for acme-beta; 3) Maya: schedule customer call and pause their nightly jobs; 4) Priya: update renewal risk to 'monitoring' and add spend note in CRM. ETA EOD for all.

Eli (Platform): I'll also wire a fallback route to a lower-cost quantized variant (m1-short-q4) when pool saturation >85% so we degrade gracefully. Will add config now.

Sam (SRE): Adding an alert: queue_depth > 30 OR avg_wait > 20s -> page on weekdays. Also will watch error rate (5xx) but current 5xx is stable at 0.2%.

Deploy Bot: change queued: add-burst-nodes gamma count=4 ttl=24h by sam. (ci-deploy/infra change id: ci-3321)

Maya (CS Ops): For renewal note — spend jump flagged but customer receptive to tune jobs. Renewal risk: low->medium if we don't reduce the spike. I'll include proposed cost-control playbook in the invite.

Priya (CSM): Notes for the onboarding tracker: mark "Gamma dedicated pool: throttles applied" + link to ticket #CS-4271. I'll follow up with a short writeup for the customer.

Eli (Platform): Follow-up: I'll push concurrency limit and fallback routing in the next 30m and post the config snippet here.

Sam (SRE): Update: burst nodes scheduled, monitoring live. Initial effect: queue depth down from 46 to 28 within 12m. Will keep an eye for rebound. :thumbsup:

Priya (CSM): Thanks team. Maya, please update the onboarding status and attach the cost playbook. Will reconvene tomorrow if numbers don't normalize.

Maya (CS Ops): On it. Scheduling call with acme-beta for 09:30 UTC.

Priya (CSM): Closing notes: current risk = moderate short-term, mitigations in flight. Will escalate to AM if spend continues rising past +50% MoM.
